notes.text: Hyman’s notice has Chanina and an abbreviated title. The linked Gemara has Rabbi Chananya bar Minyomi, who recites a baraita from the school of Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov.
[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1476&lang=en) heads his notice with Chanina but gives Chananya when citing this occurrence in Yoma.
